_about: English copy for the whole site. One file per language: the file name is the language code and it maps to the domain that serves that language (en -> the .com, ru -> the .ru, and so on). Every string a visitor can see or a screen reader can read lives in this file - nothing is written into the components. Keys starting with _ are notes for whoever edits this file; they are never rendered. Lists (faq.items, tools.items, comparison.rows, ...) are read at their own length in every file: if this file has 10 questions and ru.json has 4, the English page shows 10 and the Russian page shows 4. Keys that are missing here fall back to en.json, so a half-finished translation still renders.

items.q: Can I use it on any photo?

items.q: How does this undress AI compare to ClothOff or Undress.cc?
